hook.say: The Switch 2 piracy era is here.

stories.head: Hacker Olmectron's nx2-relink lets jailbroken Switch 2 consoles run dumped games
stories.say: Three gaming stories you missed. Number one: a hacker called Olmectron released nx2-relink, a tool that lets jailbroken Switch 2 consoles run dumped games. It's experimental, and it can brick your console.

stories.head: GTA 6 animation director Mike Jones: Rockstar made 3 versions of every item interaction
stories.say: Number two: GTA 6's gameplay animation director, Mike Jones, says Rockstar made three versions of every item interaction. Both hands free, right hand free, or left.

art.label: both hands free / right hand free / left

stories.head: Report: Ubisoft asks teams pitching new games to justify not using generative AI
stories.say: And number three: Ubisoft is reportedly asking teams pitching new games to justify not using generative AI. That's per sources speaking to Vertical Slice.

outro.head: Would you ever jailbreak a Switch 2?
outro.say: Would you ever jailbreak a Switch 2? Follow Level Up!
